title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text: 4. Calls for the EU to respect the democratic choice of the Georgian people, as was clearly expressed in the 2024 parliamentary and 2025 local elections and, furthermore, reflected in recent opinion polls; warns that by continuing its confrontational approach and supporting efforts to overturn a legitimate election result, the EU is undermining democracy in Georgia;
